page_title: PSG 2-1 PAR | PSG v Paris FC 04/01/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The match has just finished.
90+6' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) goes for goal, but slices it wide of the target.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Bradley Barcola (PSG).
89' Substitution. Thibault De Smet walks off the pitch and Tuomas Ollila (Paris FC) comes on as a substitute.
89' The substitution is prepared. Mohamed Dao (Paris FC) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Adama Camara.
89' That will be all from Willem Geubbels who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Julien Lopez (Paris FC).
89' The linesman signals that Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
83' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Senny Mayulu is replaced by Noah Nsoki (PSG).
80' Flag goes up against Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
80' Substitution. Lucas Hernandez (PSG) on for Nuno Mendes.
79' Senny Mayulu (PSG) turns on the edge of the box and immediately fires in a shot at goal, but the keeper can relax as it spins well wide of the left post.
77' Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC) attempts a volley towards the middle of the target, but it's saved by the keeper.

77' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the middle of the net is denied by Lucas Chevalier. This effort really didn't trouble him.
77' Stephane Gilli has decided to substitute Alimani Gory and he is replaced by Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).
70' We are about to witness a substitution. Marquinhos (PSG) is replacing Ilya Zabarnyi.
70' Substitution. Ousmane Dembele makes his way off the pitch and Goncalo Ramos (PSG) comes on as his replacement.
70' Luis Enrique has decided to make a change. Bradley Barcola (PSG) replaces Desire Doue.
68' The referee allows time for a substitution. Jonathan Ikone will be replaced by Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC).
67' The referee points to the corner flag and PSG will take a corner.
67' Nuno Mendes (PSG) unleashes a first-time shot which stings the gloves of the goalkeeper.
63' Adama Camara (Paris FC) got the ball on the edge of the box and fired in a first-time shot on goal, but his effort floated well over the bar. High, wide and not at all handsome.
58' Thibault De Smet (Paris FC) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
53' 2 - 1 Goal! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) picks up the ball inside the box, finds himself in a good position and fires in a shot which is deflected past Kevin Trapp. He makes it 2:1.
51' 1 - 1 Goal! Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) puts the ball into the right side of the goal past the outstretched arm of Lucas Chevalier.
51' Willem Geubbels (Paris FC) will take the responsibility and he is already preparing the ball.
49' Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
49' Referee Benoit Bastien sees the trip by Ilya Zabarnyi (PSG) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. The referee points to the penalty spot. Paris FC are awarded a penalty kick!
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+5' Benoit Bastien has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+4' Willian Pacho (PSG) connects with a cross and powers a header goalwards, but his effort goes just over the bar.
45+3' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
45+2' Nuno Mendes (PSG) takes a mid-range shot, but the ball sails high over the bar.
45+2' Kevin Trapp makes a decent save to thwart the attempt by Desire Doue (PSG).
45+2' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Desire Doue (PSG).
45' 4 additional min. will be played.
45' 1 - 0 Goal! Fabian Ruiz displays great vision and sends a pass to Desire Doue (PSG), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball into the top of the net. The score is 1:0.
43' A quickly taken corner by PSG.
43' Desire Doue (PSG) unleashes a bullet of a shot that is blocked by a defender. The ball goes behind for a corner. PSG will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
43' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for PSG.
41' Senny Mayulu (PSG) unleashes a shot, but it's well wide of the left-hand post.
40' Desire Doue (PSG) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
39' The PSG players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
36' Fabian Ruiz (PSG) controls a reverse pass deep inside the box and smacks the ball low towards the middle of the goal, but the Kevin Trapp anticipates well and smothers the ball.
35' An attempted cross from Desire Doue (PSG) is cleared.
32' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) hits a dipping shot from the edge of the box that's well off target and flies miles wide of the left post.
29' Nuno Mendes (PSG) unleashes a powerful shot from the free kick but it only hits the defensive wall.
28' PSG will take a free kick.
28' VAR review of the penalty decision hasn’t taken long and it’s NO PENALTY! The PSG players are stunned.
28' Hang on! It might not be a penalty for PSG as the ref now wants to review using VAR. This hopefully won't take too long.
27' Otavio (Paris FC) jumps into a tackle and Benoit Bastien signals a foul. The referee uncompromisingly points to the spot and it's a penalty to PSG.
25' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
23' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
19' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Warren Zaire-Emery (PSG) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Joao Neves (PSG) creates himself some space and attempts to put the ball into the box. However, the defender gets an important foot in to clear.
18' Benoit Bastien blows his whistle and it's Desire Doue (PSG) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
16' Nuno Mendes (PSG) goes for goal but he blazes his shot well over the top.
15' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) works the corner short.
15' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Desire Doue (PSG) but poses no threat.
11' Kevin Trapp (Paris FC) is able to continue to play.
10' Kevin Trapp (Paris FC) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
4' Paris FC have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
3' Vitinha (PSG) attempts to surprise the keeper with a nice shot, but the ball goes narrowly wide of the right post.
2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from PSG comes to nothing.
2' A pass into the penalty area from Nuno Mendes (PSG) is intercepted by the defence. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for PSG.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Paris FC will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien will supervise the game today.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
